requestTransactionIdentifier.description: 128-bit Globally unique identifier (GUID) assigned to each request.

partyRoleIdentifier.description: The unique identifier assigned to the party role.

partyRoleType.description: Identifies the role that the party plays in the transaction. Parties may be either a person or legal entity. A party may play multiple roles in a transaction.

partyRoleTypeOtherDescription.description: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when "Other" is selected for Party Role Type.

requestTransactionIdentifier.description: 128-bit Globally unique identifier (GUID) assigned to each request.

loanIdentifier.description: A unique identifier assigned by an entity to identify the loan

loanIdentifierType.description: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of loan identifier.

loanOriginationSystemVendorIdentifier.description: A unique identifier agreed upon by the parties to the transaction to identify the vendor of the loan origination system used to process the loan

loanOriginationSystemVersionIdentifier.description: Specifies the version of the loan origination system used to process the loan

addressLineText.description: The address with the address number, pre-directional, street name, post-directional, address unit designators and address unit value.

addressUnitIdentifier.description: The identifier value associated with the Secondary Address Unit Designator of the subject property.

postalCode.description: The postal code (ZIP Code in the US) for the address. ZIP Code may be either 5 or 9 digits.

stateCode.description: The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province, Military APO FPO, or Territory.

stateCode.description: The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province, Military APO FPO, or Territory.

fipsCountyCode.description: Code identifying the county. (Designator Code based on Federal Information Processing Standard Publication 6-4).

fipsStateNumericCode.description: A unique two digit numeric code to identify each State and State equivalent entity. These State codes are part of the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS), an official coding system developed by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST, formerly the National Bureau of Standards), U.S. Department of Commerce, and maintained by the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS).

countyName.description: The county name of the area.

appraisalFormType.description:
Specifies the form used to provide the property valuation.
Note: Data field no longer supported in MISMO 3.6v

appraisalMismoVersion.description:
Specifies the MISMO version for the appraisal data.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

propertyDesignStyleDescription.description: A free form text field used to further describe the property features. The text prior to the semicolon includes the Attachment Type and Number of Levels.  The text after the semicolon includes a description of the style.

attachmentType.description: Specifies the type of physical attachment, if any, between the dwelling units.

projectDesignType.description: This field specifies the type of design for the multiple-unit buildings in a project

accessoryUnitIndicator.description: Indicates if a one-unit property has an accessory unit in addition to the main unit.

PUDIndicator.description: When true, indicates that the project in which the subject property is located is a Planned Unit Development (PUD).

appraisaleffectivedate.description: Effective date of the appraisal on the subject property.

projectName.description: The legal name of the project in which the subject property is located.

neighborhoodName.description: The name of the neighbourhood in which the subject property is located as recognized by the municipality or residents of the municipality.

PUDLegalName.description: The name of the planned Unit Development.

projectDeveloperControlledIndicator.description: When true, indicates that developer/builder is in control of the Home Owner's Association.

siteZoningComplianceDescription.description: A free-form text field describing any issues concerning how the site complies with zoning regulations including limitations on future development.

homeOwnersAssociationDuesPaymentAmountYe.description: The portion of the yealy mortgage payment that represents funds for the homeowner's association dues.

homeOwnersAssociationDuesPaymentAmountMo.description: The portion of the monthly mortgage payment that represents funds for the homeowner's association dues.

propertyRightsAppraised.description: Indicates the type of ownership rights in the subject property - Fee Simple or Leasehold. Can include text comment.

neighborhoodCharacteristicsDescription.description:
A free-form text field used to describe the bordering streets and the physical and economic characteristics of the neighborhood.
Note: Data field no longer supported in MISMO 3.6v

neighborhoodBoundariesDescription.description: AA free-form text field describing the boundaries of the subject neighborhood. These boundaries may include but are not limited to streets, legally recognized neighborhood boundaries, waterways, or other natural boundaries that define the separation of one neighborhood from another.
neighborhoodBoundariesDescription.example: Boundaried to the N by Providence Road W, S by Ardrey Kell Road, W by Johnston Road, and E by  Community House Road.

neighborhoodDescription.description:
A free-form text field describing the neighborhood.
Note: Data field no longer supported in MISMO 3.6v
neighborhoodDescription.example: No adverse neighborhood factors were noted. The subject is located in reasonable proximity to shopping, employment, schools, and churches. Neighborhood has average market appeal and acceptance. Commerical uses have no adverse affect on value. Neighborhood has mix of residential properties.

siteZoningClassificationDescription.description: A free-form text field used to describe the zoning classification of the property site.

specialFloodHazardAreaIndicator.description: Flag that indicates if any portion of the building/mobile home is in an identified Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA) and that flood insurance is required.

NFIPFloodZoneIdentifier.description:
The flood zone covering the building or mobile home.
Note: Data field no longer supported in MISMO 3.6v

livingUnitCount.description: The number of separate living units in the structure, including any accessory dwelling units.

propertyStructureBuiltYear.description: The calendar year in which the construction of the structure was completed.

energyEfficientItemDescription.description:
A free-form text field describing energy efficient items.
Note: Data field no longer supported in MISMO 3.6v

structureAreaMeasure.description: A measurement that specifies the total interior area of the structure (a.k.a. gross building area (GBA)). The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.

landOwnedInCommonIndicator.description:
When true, indicates land associated with the subject property parcel is owned by an association, condominium project, or cooperative.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

projectLegalStructureType.description:
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the form of ownership of a project. The Project Legal Structure Type defines the quality and quantity of project ownership and rights accruing to the individual unit owner.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

appraisalAssignmentType.description:
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the method by which the property value was assessed.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

documentType.description:
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents either a category of document or a category and sublevel of a document combined into a single enumeration.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

livingUnitExcludingADUCount.description:
The number of separate living units in the subject property, excluding any accessory dwelling units.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

constructionMethodType.description:
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the manner in which the structure was constructed.
Note: Data field new to MISMO 3.6v

propertyMatchMessage.example: Freddie Mac did not find any appraisal data matching the property information.

conditionRiskIndicator.description: When true, one or more of the appraisals for the subject property indicates a condition rating of C5 or C6.

qualityRiskIndicator.description: When true, one or more of the appraisals for the subject property indicates a quality rating of Q6.

appraisalData.neighborhoodDescription:
***SEE ATTACHED ADDENDUM*** THE INTENDED USER OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT IS THE LENDER/CLIENT. THE INTENDED USE IS TO EVALUATE THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS APPRAISAL FOR A MORTGAGE FINANCE TRANSACTION, SUBJECT TO THE STATED SCOPE OF WORK, PURPOSE OF THE APPRAISAL, REPORTING REQUIREMENTS OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT FORM, AND THE DEFINITION OF MARKET VALUE. NO ADDITIONAL INTENDED USERS ARE IDENTIFIED BY THE APPRAISER. 

I CERTIFY THAT THIS APPRAISAL REPORT WAS COMPLETED IN COMPLIANCE WITH ALL CURRENT APPRAISER INDEPENDENCE REQUIREMENTS AS DEFINED BY THE DODD-FRANK WALL STREET REFORM AND CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, FANNIE MAE, FREDDIE MAC AND THE FEDERAL HOUSING ADMINISTRATION. 

I HAVE PERFORMED NO SERVICES, AS AN APPRAISER OR IN ANY OTHER CAPACITY, REGARDING THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS REPORT WITHIN THE THREE-YEAR PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING ACCEPTANCE OF THIS ASSIGNMENT. 

A REASONABLE EXPOSURE TIME FOR THE SUBJECT PROPERTY AT THE OPINION OF VALUE INDICATED IS ESTIMATED TO BE LESS THAN 3 MONTHS AND WAS DERIVED USING SUBJECT MARKET RESEARCH SUCH AS 1004MC. 

THE PHYSICAL INSPECTION OF THE PROPERTY IS NECESSARY TO GATHER THE DATA FOR AN APPRAISAL OF MARKET VALUE. THE APPRAISAL REPORT IS NOT A PROFESSIONAL HOME INSPECTION REPORT. THE APPRAISER IS NOT QUALIFIED AS A STRUCTURAL EXPERT OR HOME ENGINEER. THE APPRAISER HAS NOT TESTED THE PROPERTY'S INSULATION OR TESTED FOR THE PRESENCE OF RADON GAS. UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED. THE INSULATION ADEQUACY IS CONSIDERED TYPICAL OF THE NEIGHBORHOOD AND EVERY EFFORT HAS BEEN MADE TO CONFIRM SUCH ADEQUACY WITH THE OWNER, OCCUPANT OR OTHER THIRD PARTY KNOWLEDGEABLE ABOUT THE PROPERTY. NO OBVIOUS EVIDENCE OF TERMITES OR PEST INFESTATION EXISTS UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED ON THE APPRAISAL REPORT. THE APPRAISER IS NOT QUALIFIED TO DETECT TERMITES OR OTHER SUCH INFESTATIONS. TERMITE INSPECTIONS ARE CUSTOMARY IN THE AREA AND SHOULD BE PERFORMED BY QUALIFIED PEST CONTROL EXPERT. NO OPINION IS RENDERED IN THE APPRAISAL REPORT AS TO THE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY OF THE PROPERTY.

THE SUBJECT HAS BEEN UPDATED AND IS MARKETABLE IN ITS PRESENT CONDITION. THE EFFECTIVE AGE IS SIGNIFICANTLY LESS THAN IT'S ACTUAL AGE. 

PERSONAL PROPERTY WAS NOT INCLUDED IN THIS APPRAISAL.

AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION, THE SUBJECT UNIT WAS WINTERIZED AND ALL UTILITIES WERE TURNED OFF.

DEUTSCHE BANK TRUST COMPANY AMERICAS, C/O OCWEN LOAN SERVICING LLC.

SUPPORTING SERVICES INCLUDE SHOPPING, RECREATION, AND EMPLOYMENT ARE READILY AVAILABLE. ESSENTIAL POLICE, FIRE, MEDICAL AND SCHOOL SERVICES ENHANCE THE SUBJECTS MARKET APPEAL.

THE PREDOMINANT VALUE OF SUBJECT'S NEIGHBORHOOD IS HIGHER THAN THE SUBJECT PROPERTY'S MARKET VALUE. HOWEVER, THE APPRAISED VALUE OF THE SUBJECT IS WITHIN THE PRICE RANGE OF THE NEIGHBORHOOD AND THE SUBJECT IS NOT CONSIDERED AN UNDER-IMPROVEMENT AND IT SHOULD NOT IMPACT THE MARKETABILITY OF THE SUBJECT.

THE 10% LAND USE IS VACANT LAND, LOCAL AND FEDERAL GOVERNMENT USES. THIS SHOULD NOT IMPACT THE MARKETABILITY OF THE SUBJECT.

THE SELLER PAYING POINTS AND OR CLOSING COSTS IN AMOUNTS UP TO 0-5% OF SALES PRICE IS TYPICAL OF THE LOCAL MARKET. MARKET CONDITIONS INDICATES A PROBABLE MARKETING TIME FOR  THE SUBJECT OF  30-100+- DAYS. SETTLED SALES FOR PROPERTIES COMPARABLES TO THE SUBJECT AND IN THE SAME MARKET AREA HAVE BEEN PLACED UNDER CONTRACT IN APPROXIMATELY 30-100+- DAYS INDICATING AVERAGE DEMAND FOR PROPERTIES IN THIS MARKET AREA.
